selected_findings.title: Repreviewing after column removal crashes the workspace
selected_findings.why_it_matters: After previewing two mapped output columns, remove one and click Preview all rows. preview() clears dirty before the asynchronous worker returns, while Session.send() retains the previous view. The output table therefore maps the previous two values against the current one-field workflow; workflow.fields[1] is undefined and reading its id throws, unmounting the workspace and losing the session. Trying the three-column sample from a previously previewed workflow with more than three fields has the same failure. selected_findings.title: Canceled file-read failures can clear a newer operation
selected_findings.why_it_matters: If an earlier File.arrayBuffer() rejects after cancellation and a retry or different upload has started, this catch clears the newer operation's busy state and replaces its status message. Controls become enabled while its worker request is still active, so another upload can overwrite the pending request and discard the newer result.

selected_findings.title: Failed sample import overwrites the active mapping
selected_findings.why_it_matters: After a user has a valid active CSV, a failed sample import leaves the old view in place. This effect treats that old view as a successful sample import and runs the sample mapping against the old file, replacing the user's current mapping and potentially hiding the import error. If the source headers happen to match, the user can download a conversion of the old file while believing the sample was loaded.

selected_findings.suggested_fix: Treat sample loading as a replacement transaction: preserve the previous UI workflow and dirty state, commit the sample configuration only with its successful matching worker view, and restore the snapshot on cancellation or failure. Keep export blocked until UI workflow and recovered View share the same configuration.
selected_findings.title: Cancelled sample import leaves the displayed workflow mismatched
selected_findings.why_it_matters: Start with a valid custom one-column workflow, choose Try sample data, cancel during file reading/import, then Retry active file. sample() has already replaced the UI workflow and marked it clean, but cancellation clears samplePending and Session retains the prior active file and prior workflow. Retry evaluates that prior workflow. The recovered preview shows the sample's three headers with the original workflow's one output value, and Download is enabled even though its CSV uses the original header and does not match the displayed configuration. This persists after recovery, independently of the transient rendering crash.
